description: Figure 7 is a grouped bar chart titled "Factual Errors" that displays the number of questions, out of 40, where the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generated by GPT3 using three different methods contains at least one factual error. The horizontal axis lists four datasets: HotpotQA, 2WikiMqa, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical axis is scaled linearly from 0 to 35, representing the count of such questions. For each dataset, three grouped bars are shown, each corresponding to a method: NoR QA (orange, solid fill), OneR QA (red, dotted fill), and IRCot QA (blue, diagonal hatching). The bars are arranged side-by-side for each dataset. The chart visually confirms the caption's claim that IRCot QA has the fewest factual errors, followed by OneR QA, and then NoR QA having the most. Specifically, the values shown on the chart are: for HotpotQA, 15 (NoR QA), 10 (OneR QA), and 5 (IRCoT QA); for 2WikiMqa, 29 (NoR QA), 23 (OneR QA), and 23 (IRCoT QA); for MuSiQue, 28 (NoR QA), 27 (OneR QA), and 23 (IRCoT QA); and for IIRC, 15 (NoR QA), 14 (OneR QA), and 11 (IRCoT QA). The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the datasets along the x-axis.
